Crescendo Academy of Music

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create an elegant, inspiring homepage for a music academy called "Crescendo Academy of Music" — a community music school offering private lessons, group classes, and ensemble programs for all ages and skill levels, from first-time beginners to pre-conservatory students. Located in a renovated historic theater in Nashville, Tennessee. The design should feel refined, creative, and welcoming — balancing artistic sophistication with warm accessibility.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Crescendo" in an elegant serif font with a subtle treble clef integrated into the "C" — color: #7C3AED (violet-600)
- Links: Programs, Instructors, Schedule, Recitals, Enroll
- Right side: "Call Us: (615) 555-0192" text, "Book a Free Trial" CTA button (solid #7C3AED violet-600, white text)
- Background: white with thin bottom border (#E5E7EB)
- Sticky on scroll with backdrop blur
- Mobile: logo + hamburger + "Book Trial" mini CTA

Design: Elegant, warm, creative. Primary: #7C3AED (violet-600) for CTAs, accents, and brand elements. Background alternating between white (#FFFFFF) and #FAF5FF (violet-50). Text: #1E1033 (deep purple-black) for headings, #4B5563 (gray-600) for body. Typography: Cormorant Garamond for headlines (elegant, musical serif), Inter for body text. Cards with 12px border-radius, soft shadows. Warm photography with golden-hour lighting and natural tones. Musical elements (subtle staff lines, note accents) used sparingly as decorative touches. Generous whitespace throughout — sophisticated without being cold.

Responsive: Mobile-first. Hero height adjusts to 65vh. Program cards become horizontal scroll. Instructor cards become 1-column with larger headshots. Event cards stack vertically. Trial lesson form inputs stack. Map and info stack (map first). All touch targets minimum 44px. Navigation collapses to hamburger with full-screen overlay menu. "Book Trial" CTA remains visible in mobile nav.
